item.name: Get delivery zones and pickup points hashes

request.name: Get delivery zones and pickup points hashes

description.content:
Retrieves the delivery zones and the pickup points available for a given location, based on postal code, geographic coordinates, and country. This endpoint returns both the delivery zones hash (`deliveryZonesHash`) and the pickup points hash (`pickupPointsHash`) in a single response.

Both hashes represent the shopper's fulfillment context and are used by the [Get delivery suggestions](https://developers.vtex.com/docs/api-reference/delivery-promise-suggestions-api#get-/api/delivery-promise-suggestions) and [Search delivery suggestions](https://developers.vtex.com/docs/api-reference/delivery-promise-suggestions-api#post-/api/delivery-promise-suggestions/_search) endpoints, as well as by the [Intelligent Search API](https://developers.vtex.com/docs/api-reference/intelligent-search-api) endpoints. In the delivery suggestions endpoints, `deliveryZonesHash` is required and `pickupPointsHash` (sent as `pickupsHash`) is optional.

>ℹ️ This is the recommended endpoint for generating the fulfillment context hashes. It replaces the [Search delivery zones](https://developers.vtex.com/docs/api-reference/delivery-promise-suggestions-api#post-/api/logistics-shipping/delivery-zones/_search/v2) and [Search pickup points](https://developers.vtex.com/docs/api-reference/delivery-promise-suggestions-api#post-/api/logistics-shipping/pickuppoints/_search) endpoints, which are deprecated.

## Hash expiration

Both hashes returned by this endpoint have a time to live (TTL) of 30 minutes. After this period, they expire and are no longer valid for use in the Delivery Promise Suggestions API and the Intelligent Search API. Requests sent with an expired hash may be rejected or return invalid responses.

To generate new hashes, call this endpoint again. There is no penalty or side effect in regenerating them. We recommend that integrations relying on these hashes call this endpoint as close as possible to the moment the hashes are used, and handle the expired hash scenario by requesting new ones.

## Permissions

Any user or [API key](https://developers.vtex.com/docs/guides/api-authentication-using-api-keys) must have at least one of the appropriate [License Manager resources](https://help.vtex.com/en/tutorial/license-manager-resources--3q6ztrC8YynQf6rdc6euk3) to be able to successfully run this request. Otherwise, they will receive a `403` status code. These are the applicable resources for this endpoint:

| **Product** | **Category** | **Resource** |
| --------------- | ----------------- | ----------------- |
| Logistics | Logistics access | **Logistics full access** |
| Logistics | Logistics access | **Logistics shipping full access** |

You can [create a custom role](https://help.vtex.com/en/tutorial/roles--7HKK5Uau2H6wxE1rH5oRbc#creating-a-role) with that resource or use one of the following [predefined roles](https://help.vtex.com/en/tutorial/predefined-roles--sjGDurZKJHvHJS13LnO7Dy):

| **Role** | **Resource** | 
| --------------- | ----------------- | 
| Logistics - Full access | Logistics full access |
| Logistics - Full access | Logistics shipping full access |

>❗ Assigning a [predefined role](https://help.vtex.com/en/tutorial/predefined-roles--jGDurZKJHvHJS13LnO7Dy) to users or API keys usually grants permission to multiple [License Manager resources](https://help.vtex.com/en/tutorial/license-manager-resources--3q6ztrC8YynQf6rdc6euk3). If some of these permissions are not necessary, consider creating a custom role instead. For more information regarding security, see [Best practices for using API keys](https://help.vtex.com/en/tutorial/best-practices-api-keys--7b6nD1VMHa49aI5brlOvJm).

To learn more about machine authentication at VTEX, see [Authentication overview](https://developers.vtex.com/docs/guides/authentication).

Retrieves delivery and pickup suggestions for products using query parameters. This method supports caching, bookmarking, and browser optimizations. The response contains suggestions for each requested product, including [available delivery and pickup options](https://help.vtex.com/docs/tutorials/delivery-options-beta#creating-delivery-options) with timing information and selection criteria tags (e.g., fastest, nearest).

>⚠️ The `deliveryZonesHash` and `pickupsHash` values expire 30 minutes after being generated. Requests sent with an expired hash may be rejected or return invalid responses. To get new hashes, call the [Get delivery zones and pickup points hashes](https://developers.vtex.com/docs/api-reference/delivery-promise-suggestions-api#post-/api/logistics-shipping/zones/_search) endpoint again. There is no penalty or side effect in regenerating them, so we recommend generating the hashes as close as possible to the moment they are used.

## Hash combinations

The `deliveryZonesHash` parameter is required in every request. The `pickupsHash` parameter is optional. If you send it, send it together with the required `deliveryZonesHash`. The table below shows the valid combinations:

| **`deliveryZonesHash`** | **`pickupsHash`** | **Valid** |
| --------------- | ----------------- | ----------------- |
| Sent | Not sent | ✅ Yes |
| Sent | Sent | ✅ Yes |
| Not sent | Sent | ❌ No |
| Not sent | Not sent | ❌ No |

Example with only `deliveryZonesHash`:

```
GET /api/delivery-promise-suggestions?products[0].productId=123&deliveryZonesHash=abc123def456
```

Example with `deliveryZonesHash` and `pickupsHash`:

```
GET /api/delivery-promise-suggestions?products[0].productId=123&deliveryZonesHash=abc123def456&pickupsHash=xyz789uvw012
```

The Delivery Promise Suggestions API provides real-time suggestions for delivery and pickup options based on product availability, user location, and fulfillment context for stores that use  [Delivery Promise](https://help.vtex.com/docs/tutorials/delivery-promise-beta) and [Delivery Options](https://help.vtex.com/en/docs/tutorials/delivery-options-beta). It helps optimize the customer shopping experience by suggesting the best fulfillment options for each product. 

>ℹ️ This API is in beta, which means that we are working to improve it. If you have any questions, please contact our [Support Center](https://support.vtex.com/hc/en-us/requests).
